senses.gloss: m. (עָבַר) pitchfork for the first stage of winnowing (passing the grain from one side to the other).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:7">Kel. XIII, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 4:6">T’bul Yom IV, 6</cite>. [Ar. reads <cite ref="M02068"><he>מעדר</he></cite>, with Var. lect. <cite ref="M02055"><he>מעבר</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02153"><he>מעפר</he></cite>.]
